why_this_paper_matters: This paper identifies a specific molecular pathway (ALDH2/SIRT1) that regulates mitochondrial homeostasis in diabetes-induced cardiomyocyte senescence, providing a potential therapeutic target for reducing cardiac arrhythmias in diabetic patients. However, it focuses on a single disease context (diabetes) and does not provide multi-omics data for broader senescence analysis.
